cases.description: A default a modifier kept is produced once, by its own read, and every later read of it answers the text recorded, reporting nothing again.
A read of a default whose own production is in progress is refused at once, whether or not a bound is kept: it answers the empty string and fails nothing.
A read of a default whose own production is in progress, made by the conversion of a modifier's answer, is refused at once: the conversion is handed the empty string and goes on, and nothing fails.

A read of a default whose own production is in progress, made in a resolution a modifier asks for on the same thread of execution, is refused at once: it answers the empty string, and nothing fails in either resolution.
As many counted reads of kept inputs as the bound lets stand at once each produce their text.
A counted read past the bound is refused: it answers the empty string and fails nothing.
A counted read past the bound made by the conversion of a modifier's answer is refused: the conversion is handed the empty string and goes on, and nothing fails.
A refused read is not recorded, so a later read of the same input that is not refused produces its text.
Own reads made inside counted reads are the walk's and count toward no bound, so they stand as deep as the nesting limit allows.
A modifier stays current in a resolution it asks for, so a read of its own default made there by the conversion of an answer is the walk's and counts toward no bound.

A modifier the format defines is current while it runs, as a host-defined one is, so a read of a default another modifier kept, made by the conversion of an answer while it produces the option it selected, is no modifier's own: it is counted, and past the bound it is refused.

A resolution asked for inside another counts toward the bound where the adapter states that it does, and one asked for past the bound is refused: the modifier that asked fails, its placeholder takes its fallback chain, and every resolution around it answers.
